senses.definition: A self-contained component of a system, often interchangeable, which has a well-defined interface to the other components.

quotes.text: A friend who’s spent decades as an auto mechanic recently confided that he’s grateful to be nearing retirement. “These Teslas,” he told me, “they’re not even cars anymore – they’re computers on wheels. When something goes wrong, you don’t fix it; you just replace entire modules.” What was once a craft that any dedicated person could learn has become an exercise in supervised dependency.

senses.definition: (architecture) A standard unit of measure used for determining the proportions of a building.

quotes.text: Class modules are similar to form modules except they do not have a visible interface (GUI).
